newsitem.title: SPAIN: Venezuela 1997 output to grow about 4 pct-Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela 1997 output to grow about 4 pct-Matos.

text.p: Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said on Tuesday that Venezuela's 1997 output was expected to grow by around 4.0 percent.

"In 1997, in fact, output is expected to grow around 4.0 percent, a sign that we hope will mark the beginning of a cycle of fresh growth and new jobs," he said in a speech at the Inter-American Development Bank annual meeting.
He said investor confidence had increased, the process of privatisation and economic opening was well underway and the financial system was well consolidated.
"All of these factors point to recovery of the real sector of the economy," Matos said.
He also said Venezuela was committed to principles of solid fiscal management.
"Our attention continues to focus on bringing inflation down, whence the importance of pursuing the basic principles of sound fiscal management," he said. --IADB newsroom +34 3 424 2834
